fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects enumeration of local or remote network services.
fields.name: MacOS Network Service Scanning
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "/nc" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/netcat") and (not tgt.process.cmdline contains "l")) or (tgt.process.image.path contains "/nmap" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/telnet")))
